fields.name: work_memory
fields.meaning: Working memory the game uses while running (not part of the save; rewritten at power-on and during play)
fields.evidence: diff: changes at power-on with no input and between every play session; the loader never reads it from here

fields.name: start_marker
fields.meaning: Copy A start marker, always 2; the loader rejects the copy if it is not 2
fields.evidence: code: writer a000:abd5 sets it, checker a000:ad22 tests it; value 02 in every natural save

fields.name: body_length
fields.meaning: Length of the save body: 0x0903 (2307). The end marker sits at 0x003+length and the checksum right after it
fields.evidence: code: a000:adc1 passes 0x903 to a000:abd5, a000:ad22 reads it back; value 03 09 in every natural save

fields.name: magic
fields.meaning: Game ID text "デジアド02_V0001" (half-width katakana with separate voiced-mark bytes, then ASCII) plus a zero byte, copied from the cartridge; loading compares all 16 bytes and treats a mismatch as a bad copy
fields.evidence: code: a000:adc1 copies ROM 857E:000E to the save image, a000:aeca compares 16 bytes; decodes cleanly

fields.name: party_records
fields.meaning: Three partner Digimon records of 104 (0x68) bytes each, in party slot order (record 2 at +0x68, record 3 at +0xD0; per-record layout in the rows below)
fields.evidence: code: copied from working address 0x0978 by a000:adc1; new game fills 3 records; status screens show the same 3 Digimon

fields.name: rec_in_use
fields.meaning: Record 1: slot used flag (1 = filled; the party is packed so empty slots move to the end)
fields.evidence: code: b000:3f09 tests +0 and compacts; 01 in all 3 records

fields.name: rec_species
fields.meaning: Record 1: Digimon species number (0xBE V-mon, 0xC5 Wormmon, 0x02 Agumon)
fields.evidence: code: e000:9bb3 creates each species via b000:3d29, c000:137b marks it seen; status screens

fields.name: rec_name
fields.meaning: Record 1: Digimon name in the game's own text code, padded with 0xFF (ブイモン, ワームモン, アグモン); only 9 code bytes are mapped so far
fields.evidence: code: e000:9bb3 copies 6 bytes into +3; status screens

fields.name: rec_h
fields.meaning: Record 1: H (hit points) current
fields.evidence: status screens for all 3 partners (288/288/392); species base set by b000:3b37, refilled by b000:4050

fields.name: rec_h_max
fields.meaning: Record 1: H maximum
fields.evidence: status screens; derived at creation by b000:50b5; refill source in b000:4050

fields.name: rec_a
fields.meaning: Record 1: A stat current
fields.evidence: status screens for all 3 partners (38/32/18); b000:3b37 base, b000:4050 refill

fields.name: rec_a_max
fields.meaning: Record 1: A stat maximum
fields.evidence: status screens; b000:3b37 base, b000:4050 refill source

fields.name: rec_p
fields.meaning: Record 1: P stat current
fields.evidence: status screens for all 3 partners (14 each); b000:3b37 base, b000:4050 refill

fields.name: rec_p_max
fields.meaning: Record 1: P stat maximum
fields.evidence: status screens; b000:3b37 base, b000:4050 refill source

fields.name: rec_s
fields.meaning: Record 1: S stat current
fields.evidence: status screens for all 3 partners (20/20/10); b000:3b37 base, b000:4050 refill

fields.name: rec_s_max
fields.meaning: Record 1: S stat maximum
fields.evidence: status screens; b000:3b37 base, b000:4050 refill source

fields.name: rec_x
fields.meaning: Record 1: current/maximum byte pair from the species table (50/50, 45/45, 40/40); which stat it is stays unknown, it is not shown on the status screens
fields.evidence: code: species base value set by b000:3b37, max copied to current by b000:4050

fields.name: rec_d
fields.meaning: Record 1: D (digi-points) current
fields.evidence: status screens for all 3 partners (88/88/72); derived by b000:50b5, refilled by b000:4050

fields.name: rec_d_max
fields.meaning: Record 1: D maximum
fields.evidence: status screens; derived by b000:50b5 (base x table / 10, cap 999)

fields.name: rec_unk_1d
fields.meaning: Record 1: always 0xFF (set when the record is cleared)
fields.evidence: code: b000:3a7c writes 0xFF to +0x1D; FF in all saves

fields.name: rec_status_flags
fields.meaning: Record 1: status flag bits; bit 0 is cleared whenever stats are refilled
fields.evidence: code: bits masked at creation by b000:3b37, bit 0 cleared by b000:4050; 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_unk_1f
fields.meaning: Record 1: flag bits masked together with +0x1E at creation
fields.evidence: code: b000:3b37 mask; 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_slot_state
fields.meaning: Record 1: 1 when the record is created, 2 once the Digimon joins at new game
fields.evidence: code: b000:3d29 writes 1, e000:9bb3 overwrites 2; 02 in all saves

fields.name: rec_prev_species
fields.meaning: Record 1: second species number: 0xBD for V-mon, 0 for the others; set at new game (maybe the form it came from)
fields.evidence: code: b000:3d29 first writes a species-table value, e000:9bb3 overwrites; values only

fields.name: rec_base_species
fields.meaning: Record 1: third species number, equal to the starting species (0xBE, 0xC5, 0x02); set at new game (maybe the base/partner form)
fields.evidence: code: e000:9bb3 writes +0x23; values only

fields.name: rec_list_a
fields.meaning: Record 1: eight bytes, all 0xFF (empty list)
fields.evidence: code: b000:3d29 fills 0xFFFF; FF in all saves

fields.name: rec_growth_param
fields.meaning: Record 1: species-table value (4/14/8), purpose unknown
fields.evidence: code: set from species table byte 0x18 by b000:3b37

fields.name: rec_unk_2e
fields.meaning: Record 1: two zero bytes
fields.evidence: code: b000:3d29 writes 0; 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_unk_30
fields.meaning: Record 1: zero
fields.evidence: code: b000:3d29 writes 0; 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_unk_31

fields.evidence: code: b000:3d29 writes 1; 01 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_unk_33
fields.meaning: Record 1: zero (word)
fields.evidence: code: b000:3d29 writes 0; 00 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_growth_stage
fields.meaning: Record 1: growth/evolution stage from the species table (0/1/7); used as the growth-table lookup key
fields.evidence: code: species table byte 0x19 minus 1 (b000:3d29), lookup key in b000:5045 via b000:50b5

fields.name: rec_evo_param
fields.meaning: Record 1: species-table value (2 for all starters) used by the evolution-route check

fields.name: rec_unk_37

fields.name: rec_evo_route

fields.evidence: code: computed by b000:523c at creation

fields.name: rec_unk_3a
fields.meaning: Record 1: three zero bytes
fields.evidence: 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_list_b
fields.meaning: Record 1: sixteen bytes, all 0xFF (empty list)
fields.evidence: code: b000:3a7c fills 0xFF; FF in all saves

fields.name: rec_unk_4d
fields.meaning: Record 1: zero
fields.evidence: code: b000:3d29 writes 0; 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_list_c
fields.meaning: Record 1: twenty bytes, all 0xFF (empty list)

fields.name: rec_unk_62
fields.meaning: Record 1: four zero bytes
fields.evidence: 00 in all saves

fields.name: rec_steps
fields.meaning: Record 1: walked-tiles counter; grows in lockstep in all three records as the party walks and stands still in menus
fields.evidence: diff: 00 early, 9D at first save, +3 for a 3-tile walk in a later natural save; identical in all records

fields.name: rec_unk_67
fields.meaning: Record 1: zero
fields.evidence: 00 in all saves

fields.name: party_count
fields.meaning: Number of Digimon in the party (3); a received Digimon is added only while it is below 3
fields.evidence: code: b000:3f09 returns it, c000:137b loops over it, a000:aeca checks < 3

fields.name: species_bytes
fields.meaning: One byte per Digimon species (238 species); new game clears all, a test path sets all to 1 (maybe per-species unlock state)
fields.evidence: code: cleared by e000:9bb3 (set to 1 when the test flag at 0x0ED8 is set); all 0 in every natural save

fields.name: buffer_gap_1
fields.meaning: Not filled by the save routine (one byte between two copied blocks); holds whatever the save buffer had, and is covered by the checksum
fields.evidence: code: a000:adc1 copies 0xEE bytes to buffer 0x27B9 and the next block starts at 0x28A8, leaving 0x28A7; 0 in every natural save

fields.name: started_flag
fields.meaning: Set to 1 when a new game starts
fields.evidence: code: e000:9ba3 writes 1 to 0x0EDC at new game; 1 in every natural save

fields.name: unknown_3868
fields.meaning: Unknown bytes, zero in every natural save (first one cleared at new game)
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 clears; zero everywhere

fields.name: species_seen_bits
fields.meaning: Seen/registered marks for the 238 species, 2 bits per species (bit 1 of each pair = registered); new game registers V-mon, Wormmon and Agumon; party species are marked on every map entry; the Digimon list is built from it
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 sets 3 species, c000:137b marks party, d000:90a4 builds the list; exactly those 3 species set

fields.name: unknown_38b2
fields.meaning: Unknown bytes after the seen marks
fields.evidence: zero in every natural save

fields.name: unknown_377c
fields.meaning: Zero word cleared at new game (possibly the BIT money, unproven: no other code touches it and the item screen always shows 0)
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 clears; 0 everywhere

fields.name: unknown_377e
fields.meaning: Zero word cleared at new game
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 clears; 0 everywhere

fields.name: unknown_3780
fields.meaning: Unknown, zero in every natural save
fields.evidence: zero everywhere

fields.name: formation
fields.meaning: Battle formation: for each of the 3 party slots a pair (cell number, party slot); defaults (0,0),(0,1),(0,2)
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 defaults, b000:3f09 swaps pairs with records; diff: moving one Digimon one cell changed 0x6297 0 -> 1 and nothing else

fields.name: unknown_378a
fields.meaning: Unknown, zero in every natural save
fields.evidence: zero everywhere

fields.name: item_list
fields.meaning: Item list: up to 33 item numbers, 0 = empty; new game gives items 1 (D-3) and 2 (D-terminal)
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 clears 33 words and sets 1, 2; item screen shows those 2 items

fields.name: item_count
fields.meaning: Number of items in the list (2)
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 sets 2; item screen agrees

fields.name: list_37cf
fields.meaning: Second list of 51 words cleared at new game, zero in every natural save
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 clears; zero everywhere

fields.name: unknown_3835
fields.meaning: Unknown, zero in every natural save
fields.evidence: zero everywhere

fields.name: area_select
fields.meaning: Area/chapter selector; the map number is chosen from it (and from story progress)
fields.evidence: code: c000:24a0 switches on it; 0 in every natural save

fields.name: map_id
fields.meaning: Current map number (0x0E at new game, 4 in the saved plaza)
fields.evidence: code: set by c000:24a0 from area + story; observed 0x0E then 4 exactly as the table says

fields.name: room_x
fields.meaning: Room column on the current map (map table: map*35 + 8 + row*5 + column)
fields.evidence: code: c000:137b reads it for the room lookup; observed 2, and 1 during a visit next door

fields.name: room_y
fields.meaning: Room row on the current map
fields.evidence: code: c000:137b reads it; always 3 in observed play

fields.name: player_x
fields.meaning: Player position X in copy A. Edit the declared copy group to update both physical copies.
fields.evidence: Continue loaded X from copy B in the tested valid frames with different X values. When either start marker was invalid, Continue restored that frame from its valid twin. The movement and save replay rewrote both frames.

fields.name: player_y
fields.meaning: Player position Y inside the room
fields.evidence: code: c000:137b reads it (forced to 4 in some rooms); diff: walking 1 tile up changed it 05 -> 04

fields.evidence: zero everywhere

fields.name: facing

fields.evidence: diff: always equals the last walked direction (right -> 1, up -> 0, down -> 2, left -> 3 across many sessions)

fields.name: player_name
fields.meaning: Player (tamer) name in the game's own text code, padded with 0xFF; holds the 3-byte default name in every natural save (partial code table: only 9 bytes mapped)
fields.evidence: code: default copied by e000:9bb3, name entry targets it (e000:a65b), dialog splices it (c000:8624)

fields.name: stored_records
fields.meaning: Nine more 104-byte Digimon records (same size as the party records); new game clears the first byte of each (likely Digimon kept outside the party)
fields.evidence: code: c000:1263 clears byte 0 of each 0x68 record; all 0 in every natural save

fields.name: buffer_gap_2
fields.meaning: Not filled by the save routine: room for a tenth 104-byte record that is never copied (only nine of the ten records cleared at new game are saved); covered by the checksum
fields.evidence: code: a000:adc1 copies 0x3A8 bytes to buffer 0x29DF, next block at 0x2DEF; c000:1263 clears 10 records; zero everywhere

fields.name: block_4894_head
fields.meaning: 16 bytes set from the cartridge at new game (23 23 then zeros)
fields.evidence: code: e000:1eb5 copies the default; 23 23 00.. everywhere

fields.name: block_4894_mode
fields.meaning: Cleared at new game
fields.evidence: code: e000:1ece writes 0; 0 everywhere

fields.name: block_4894_slots
fields.meaning: Nine slots, 0xFF = empty
fields.evidence: code: e000:1ece fills with 0xFF; all 0xFF everywhere

fields.name: block_4894_mid
fields.meaning: Unknown, zero in every natural save
fields.evidence: zero everywhere

fields.name: default_text_4988

fields.evidence: code: e000:1ece copies ROM 9727:000E; constant everywhere

fields.name: block_4894_tail
fields.meaning: Unknown, zero in every natural save
fields.evidence: zero everywhere

fields.name: block_390e_head
fields.meaning: Unknown bytes cleared at new game
fields.evidence: code: e000:9bb3 clears; zero everywhere

fields.name: dialog_subst
fields.meaning: Dialog text substitution index: picks the ROM string spliced into dialog at marker bytes
fields.evidence: code: c000:8624 reads 0x3915 to index a string table; 0 everywhere

fields.name: block_390e_rest
fields.meaning: Unknown bytes cleared at new game
fields.evidence: code: e000:9bb3 clears; zero everywhere

fields.name: end_marker
fields.meaning: Copy A end marker, always 3
fields.evidence: code: a000:abd5 writes it at 0x003+length, a000:ad22 tests it; 03 everywhere

fields.name: checksum
fields.meaning: CRC-16/KERMIT (reflected 0x1021, start 0, no final XOR) over bytes copy+0x001..copy+0x906 (length, body and end marker), stored low byte first
fields.evidence: code: a000:2169/a000:2195 table CRC (tables a000:21A9/22A9); recomputed over every valid natural save image: all match

fields.name: gap_a
fields.meaning: Not written by the save
fields.evidence: zero everywhere; copy B starts at 0x6943

fields.name: copy_b
fields.meaning: Second copy of the whole save, same layout as 0x6000-0x6908 (both copies are written on every save; at load a bad copy is rewritten from the good one)
fields.evidence: code: a000:adc1 writes slots 0 and 1 (stride 0x943), a000:aeca checks both and repairs; copies identical everywhere

fields.name: unused_7286
fields.meaning: Not used by the save
fields.evidence: zero everywhere; no writer found

fields.name: incoming_record
fields.meaning: Inbox for one Digimon record: 16-byte game ID at 0x7600 and again at 0x7678 with a 104-byte record at 0x7610; at load, if both IDs match and the party has fewer than 3, the record is added to the party, the game re-saves and the inbox is cleared
fields.evidence: code: a000:aeca (compare, copy to 0x0978+count*0x68, re-save via a000:adc1, clear 0x88 bytes); zero everywhere; no writer found in the disassembled code

fields.name: unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not used by the save
fields.evidence: zero everywhere

fields.name: console_owner_data
fields.meaning: Console owner profile; not written by the game save
fields.evidence: diff: identical with and without a save

fields.name: player_x_copy_b
fields.meaning: Player position X in copy B. Continue loaded this value when both tested valid copies held different X values.
fields.evidence: Continue loaded X from copy B in the tested valid frames with different X values. When either start marker was invalid, Continue restored that frame from its valid twin. The movement and save replay rewrote both frames.
